text.en: First thing you do at the gym?
See who's here today
Check for new routes
Lace up and start climbing

text.zh: 以下哪个最影响你今天来不来岩馆？
text.en: What most affects whether you go to the gym today?
Whether friends are coming
Whether there are new routes

text.zh: 我攀岩跟别人没关系，想来就来
text.en: It's my own thing, I go when I want

text.zh: 你到了岩馆发现今天一个认识的人都没有，你？
text.en: You arrive at the gym and know no one there. You?
A bit bummed but still climb

text.zh: 无所谓，本来就是来爬的
text.en: Doesn't matter, I'm here to climb
Might leave early

text.zh: 你搭子说"我今天差不多了想走了"，但你还想爬。你？
text.en: Your partner wants to leave but you want to keep climbing. You?
"Alright, I'll go too"
"Go ahead, I'll stay a bit longer"
"Just one more try, please?"

text.zh: 你的搭子对于你的意义是？
text.en: What does your climbing partner mean to you?
Someone who makes climbing more fun

text.zh: 一起训练互相监督的伙伴
text.en: A training accountability partner
I don't really need a regular partner

text.zh: 有人在你旁边用很离谱的beta反复尝试一条你已经完攀的线，你什么时候会出手帮？
text.en: Someone is struggling with a weird beta on a route you've sent. When do you help?
Walk over and start chatting right away

text.zh: 等他试了几次看起来有点无奈了，再礼貌问一句要不要建议
text.en: Wait until they look frustrated, then politely offer

text.zh: 没人问我我就不主动帮
text.en: If nobody asks, I don't volunteer

text.zh: 有人主动给你beta，但你没问他。你？
text.en: Someone gives you unsolicited beta. You?
Cool, I'll listen

text.zh: 微笑说谢谢，但心里觉得我还没准备好听建议
text.en: Smile and say thanks, but not ready for advice
A bit annoyed, I want to figure it out myself

text.zh: 你搭子flash了你磨了三周的线。你的真实反应？
text.en: Your partner flashes your 3-week project. Real reaction?
Genuinely happy for them

text.zh: 佩服，同时默默决定今天一定要完攀
text.en: Impressed, secretly vow to send it today

text.zh: 脸上说牛逼，心里有那么一点不是滋味
text.en: Say 'nice' while feeling a bit bitter inside

text.zh: 连续三次掉在同一个地方。你脑子里第一个想法？
text.en: Fall at the same spot 3 times. First thought?
I'm just not strong enough yet
Probably a technique issue

text.zh: 今天状态不好 / 手皮/鞋的问题
text.en: Bad day / skin / shoe issue

text.zh: 你完攀了一条对你来说很难的线。你第一反应？
text.en: You send a hard route. First reaction?

text.zh: 内心很开心但不太表现出来
text.en: Happy inside but don't show it much

text.zh: 忍不住笑出来或者小声说个"yes"
text.en: Can't help smiling or whisper 'yes'
'Haha just lucky, just lucky'

text.zh: 你在岩馆爬得特别差的一天。你？
text.en: A really bad day at the gym. You?

text.zh: 没什么，有好有坏很正常
text.en: No big deal, ups and downs are normal

text.zh: 换去人少的区域继续，但调低难度
text.en: Move to a quiet area and lower the difficulty

text.zh: 心情受影响，可能提前走
text.en: Mood affected, might leave early

text.zh: 你去了一个定级宽松的新馆，突然爬得特别好。你？
text.en: You crush at a soft-grading gym. You?

text.zh: 换个馆就变强了？心里清楚是定级的原因
text.en: Stronger at a new gym? I know it's the grading

text.zh: 开心是开心，但知道不能当真
text.en: Happy but I know not to take it seriously

text.zh: 有一瞬间觉得"这才是我的真实水平"
text.en: For a moment think 'this is my real level'

text.zh: 你在墙上到了一个不确定能不能过的位置。你？
text.en: You reach an uncertain position on the wall. You?
Just go for it, worst case I fall
Pause and think before moving

text.zh: 挂着犹豫，上也不是下也不是
text.en: Hang there hesitating, can't go up or down

text.zh: 你在墙上的时候，楼下的人给你喊"加油"，对你来说是？
text.en: People below cheer 'go for it!' while you're climbing. For you it's?
Encouraging, gives me more energy
Pressure, makes me more nervous

text.zh: 我爬的时候听不见外面的声音
text.en: I can't hear anything when I'm climbing

text.zh: 一个比你强的人给了你beta建议，但你自己的方法也行得通。你？
text.en: A stronger climber suggests beta, but your method works. You?

text.zh: 直接用他的，人家比我强肯定有道理
text.en: Use theirs — they're better so they must be right
Try both

text.zh: 谢了，但我想用自己的方法
text.en: Thanks, but I'll use my own method
Do you have a climbing training plan?
Yes, a systematic one

text.zh: 大概知道要练什么但不严格执行
text.en: Roughly know what to work on, but don't follow strictly
No, I just climb when I'm here

text.zh: 你和你搭子的关系是什么样的？
text.en: What's your relationship with your climbing partner like?
Mutual encouragement, growing together

text.zh: 他们很努力，但我比较佛系
text.en: They work hard, but I'm chill

text.zh: 我是那个一直在push他们的人
text.en: I'm the one always pushing them

text.zh: 以下最符合你去攀岩的动机？
text.en: What best describes your climbing motivation?

text.zh: 想变强，突破自己的极限
text.en: Get stronger, push my limits

text.zh: 享受在墙上的感觉，很解压
text.en: Enjoy the feeling on the wall, it's relaxing
Love the gym vibe and the people

text.zh: 没爬上一条你觉得自己应该能完攀的线，你会？
text.en: Failed a route you thought you could send. You?

text.zh: 反复试直到爬上去或者没力气
text.en: Keep trying until I send it or run out of energy

text.zh: 换条线调整一下，改天再来
text.en: Switch routes, try again another day

text.zh: 有点不开心，默默想了一路
text.en: A bit upset, thinking about it all the way home

text.zh: 什么原因会让你想过不爬了？
text.en: What would make you consider quitting climbing?
Never thought about it

text.zh: 一直没进步，卡级太久了
text.en: No progress, stuck at a grade too long
No one to climb with anymore
Injury / physical reasons

text.zh: 你手指有点疼但还能爬，你会？
text.en: Your fingers hurt a bit but you can still climb. You?
Keep going, this pain is nothing
Lower intensity but don't stop

text.zh: 今天到此为止，不想变严重
text.en: Call it a day, don't want it to get worse

text.zh: 对于在岩馆找对象，你的想法是？
text.en: Thoughts on finding a partner at the climbing gym?

text.zh: 挺好的啊，有共同爱好的感情基础更好
text.en: Great, shared hobby makes a better foundation

text.zh: 不反对但我自己不会这么想
text.en: Not against it but wouldn't seek it myself

text.zh: 来岩馆就好好爬，别搞这些
text.en: Just climb at the gym, don't mix things

text.zh: 你在岩馆会录自己爬的视频吗？
text.en: Do you record yourself climbing at the gym?

text.zh: 经常录，回去复盘动作用
text.en: Often, to review my technique later

text.zh: 偶尔录，主要发朋友圈/小红书
text.en: Sometimes, mainly for social media
Rarely, I just climb and leave
"Grades don't matter, just have fun"
Agree
Neutral
Disagree

text.zh: "有人说自己攀岩一个月就V4，我第一反应是看他在哪个馆"
text.en: "When someone claims V4 in one month, I first check which gym"
Agree
Neutral

text.zh: "卡级超过三个月我会很焦虑"
text.en: "Being stuck at a grade for 3+ months makes me anxious"
Agree

text.zh: "我来岩馆最大的收获是认识了一群朋友"
text.en: "My biggest gain from the gym is the friends I've made"
Agree
Neutral

text.zh: "主动给别人beta是一种热心，不是冒犯"
text.en: "Offering unsolicited beta is being helpful, not rude"
Agree
Neutral

text.zh: "我经常在心里默默和旁边的人比较"
text.en: "I often silently compare myself to others around me"
Agree
Neutral

text.zh: "掉下来之前我会先自嘲一句给自己台阶下"
text.en: "Before falling I crack a joke to give myself an out"
Agree
Neutral

"Climbing beautifully matters more than climbing hard"
Agree
Neutral

text.zh: "受伤了还坚持爬说明有毅力"
text.en: "Climbing through injury shows determination"
Agree
Neutral

text.zh: "我觉得自己经常练太多但停不下来"
text.en: "I often feel like I train too much but can't stop"
Agree

GHOST.slogan: 来了就练，练完就走，不需要任何人

DO-S.slogan: 指出问题是我对你最大的尊重

NERD.slogan: 这条线没完攀，怎么能换

TALK-ER.slogan: 岩馆是一个有墙的咖啡厅

CLOWN.slogan: 哈哈我好菜啊（但我其实在乎）

TILT.slogan: 所有的比较都在心里，从来不说出口

BABY.slogan: 我正常发挥的话肯定能爬上去

LOL.slogan: 攀岩挺好玩的，不需要更多理由

MOM.slogan: 你水喝了吗？镁粉要不要补一下？

DRAMA.slogan: 有观众的时候我能多爬两个级别
